The populated PSU map, mux route, register-level allowlist, nominal telemetry/redundancy oracle and independent power recovery are indispensable project/OEM specifications.

An address response cannot prove slot identity, correct PSU population, valid telemetry, redundancy health or non-mutating behavior.
ED-03 prohibits guessed OEM topology/registers; ED-15 prohibits PASS without approved nominal telemetry, redundancy and health thresholds.
A generic i2cdetect probe is not categorically read-only for every live PMBus device and cannot replace the vendor safe-command matrix.
No SSH, I2C, PMBus, PSU, power, scan, write, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.
